# Config files

Every file termocode reads or writes. termocode never fails to start because of a missing or broken file; it uses defaults instead.

## Config folder

`~/.config/termocode/`, or `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/termocode/`.

| File | Purpose | Format | Safe to edit? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `config.json` | Settings (theme, editor, search, AI). See the settings reference. | JSON object. Unknown keys are kept on save. | Yes. Also Preferences: Open Settings (UI). |
| `keymap.json` | Key binding overrides. See the keys reference. | JSON object: key string → action name, or `"ext:<command id>"` for an extension command. | Yes. Also Preferences: Customize Keybindings. |
| `commands.json` | User commands shown in the palette as `User: <title>`. | JSON array of `{"id", "title", "cmd", "cwd"}`. | Yes. Open with Open Config: User Commands. |
| `snippets.json` | User snippets, layered over the built-in ones. | JSON object: scope (filetype or `*`) → trigger → body (string or array of lines). | Yes. Also Snippets: Manage…. |
| `user_theme.json` | Custom color theme saved by the theme editor. | JSON object: palette key (for example `BgEditor`) → hex color. Used by the `custom` theme. | Yes, but Preferences: Edit Custom Theme is easier. |
| `breakpoints.json` | Saved debugger breakpoints per file (line and line text). | JSON `{"version", "breakpoints": {file: [...]}}`. | Not needed. termocode rewrites it when breakpoints change. |
| `sessions/<hash>.json` | Session of one workspace: open files, tab order, cursor positions, expanded folders, extra workspace roots, last AI chat. The name is a hash of the workspace path; the `workspace` key says which folder. | JSON, written by termocode. | No (state). Developer: Reset Session clears the current workspace's file and keeps a `.bak`. |
| `session.json` | Layout kept across all workspaces: terminal height, Actions panel, Source Control view. A session.json from before per-workspace sessions moves to `sessions/` the first time its workspace opens. | JSON, written by termocode. | No (state). Safe to delete. |
| `recents.json` | Recent files for the welcome screen and File: Open Recent…. | JSON array. | No (state). Safe to delete. |
| `workspaces.json` | Recent workspace folders for File: Open Recent Workspace…. | JSON array. | No (state). Safe to delete. |
| `palette_recents.json` | Recently used palette commands (shown first). | JSON array of command IDs. | No (state). Safe to delete. |
| `errors.log` | Log of error and warning toasts. `tail -f` it while debugging. | Plain text, one timestamped line per entry; secrets are redacted. | Safe to delete. |
| `settings-backup-<time>.json` | Backup written before Preferences: Import Settings…. | Settings bundle (same shape as an export). | Safe to delete. |
| `extensions/<name>/` | Lua extensions: `extension.json` manifest and `init.lua`. | Folder per extension. | Yes. Extensions: New Extension… creates one. |
| `ai/credentials.json` | AI API keys, Claude OAuth tokens, MCP secrets and MCP sign-ins. File mode 0600 (folder 0700). | JSON `{"keys": {provider: key}, "claude_oauth": {...}, "mcp_secrets": {name: value}, "mcp_oauth": {server: {issuer, resource, tokens…, account}}, "mcp_accounts": {server: account}}`. | With care. Prefer AI: Configure Provider…. Never exported by Preferences: Export Settings…. |
| `ai/profiles.json` | Your agent profiles: named pipelines of AI steps (built in: default, review, fast, local-only, plan; yours win by name, except default). | JSON `{"profiles": {name: {"title", "categories": {"quick"\|"deep": slot}, "budget_usd", "steps": [{"id", "title", "slot", "category", "system", "tools": {"preset": "none"\|"read-only"\|"all", "allow", "deny"}, "output": "shown"\|"folded"\|"hidden", "max_steps", "deps", "plan"}]}}}`. At most 12 steps, system prompts up to 8 KB; `deps` needs ai_parallel_max 2 or more; at most one `plan` step; `budget_usd` pauses a run at that cost. Slots come from ai_models in config.json; no keys in this file. | Yes. A broken file is skipped (the built-in profiles stay) and the error names the line. |
| `ai/chats/*.json` | Saved AI chats (newest 50 kept). | JSON, one file per chat. | Safe to delete. |
| `mcp.json` | Your MCP servers: their tools are offered to the AI chat. See the MCP guide. | Claude Desktop / Claude Code / Cursor shape: `{"mcpServers": {name: {"command", "args", "env", "cwd"}}}` for local servers, `{"type": "http", "url", "headers"}` for remote ones, plus `readOnly`, `autoApprove`, `deny`, `timeout`, `disabled`, `oauth` (`client_id`, `client_secret`, `scopes` of a pre-registered app) and `auth` (`{"gh": "<login>"}`: the token comes from the GitHub CLI; only in this file, not in a project's). Secrets as `${secret:NAME}` (from `mcp_secrets` in ai/credentials.json) or `${VAR}`. | Yes. Open with Open Config: MCP Servers. |
| `http/saved.http` | Requests saved with HTTP: Save Request to Saved… (S on the response page). | A normal `.http` file (the format mobocode reads too). File mode 0600. | Yes. HTTP: Saved Requests… → Open saved.http. |
| `http/history.jsonl` | HTTP history: one JSON line per send (yours and the AI's). Holds the request as written (`{{templates}}`, secret headers `[REDACTED]`), never the resolved values; the first 256 KB of a text answer. File mode 0600, folder 0700. | JSON lines, written by termocode; `http_history_max` trims it. | No (state). HTTP: History… → Clear history…, or delete it. |
| `http/state.json` | The HTTP environment chosen per workspace (HTTP: Select Environment…). | JSON `{"envs": {workspace: env}}`. | Not needed. |

## Data folder

`~/.local/share/termocode/`, or `$XDG_DATA_HOME/termocode/`.

| File | Purpose | Format | Safe to edit? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `plugins/` | Neovim plugins cloned in the background on first launch (nvim-dap, vim-visual-multi, rainbow-delimiters). | Git checkouts. `$TERMOCODE_PLUGINS_DIR` moves it. | Delete to re-clone on next launch. |
| `tools/` | Language servers and debug adapters installed by LSP: Manage Language Servers… and DAP: Install Adapter…. | One folder per tool; `tools/bin` holds shims on Neovim's PATH. `$TERMOCODE_TOOLS_DIR` moves it. | Use the palette commands. Delete a tool folder to remove it. |
| `tools/asked.json` | Filetypes already asked about in the "no language server" toast. | JSON `{"filetypes": [...]}`. | Safe to delete (the toasts come back). |

## Workspace folder

Inside the folder you open.

| File | Purpose | Format | Safe to edit? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `.termocode/tasks.json` | Workspace tasks for Tasks: Run Task…. | VS Code style tasks: `label`, `command`, `args`, `cwd`, `env`, `group`, `problemMatcher`. | Yes. Tasks: Configure Tasks creates it. |
| `.termocode/services.json` | Local dev services for the Services view (and the compose file / profiles to use). | JSONC: `compose` {`file`, `profiles`, `project`}, `services` [{`name`, `command`, `cwd`, `env`, `port`, `health` {`tcp` \| `http`}}]. | Yes. Services: Configure creates it. A local command asks once before its first start. |
| `.termocode/launch.json` | Debug and run configurations. | VS Code `launch.json` shape; comments allowed. | Yes. Debug: Open launch.json creates it. |
| `.termocode/mcp.json` | Project MCP servers. An entry with the same name as one in your mcp.json replaces it; `"disabled": true` hides it in this project. | Same shape as the user mcp.json. | Yes. termocode asks before it starts a project server the first time (and again when the entry changes). |
| `.termocode/ai-profiles.json` | Project agent profiles. A profile with the same name as one of yours replaces it in this project. | Same shape as ai/profiles.json; a `models` key is ignored (a project can not point you at another server). | Yes. A broken file is skipped and the error names the line. |
| `.editorconfig` | Indent and whitespace rules, read by Neovim's EditorConfig support. | EditorConfig INI. | Yes (read only for termocode). |
| `http-client.env.json` | HTTP environments for `{{name}}` in `.http` files, next to them or in a parent folder up to the workspace root (the nearest wins). `$shared` applies to every environment. | JSON `{"$shared": {...}, "dev": {"host": "…"}, …}` (VS Code REST Client / JetBrains shape). | Yes. HTTP: Open Environment File creates it. |
| `http-client.private.env.json` | Secret values (tokens) for the same environments; they win over http-client.env.json, are hidden from the AI and the logs, and must stay out of git. | Same shape as http-client.env.json. | Yes. HTTP: Open Private Environment File creates it (mode 0600) and offers to add it to .gitignore. |

## Other files

| File | Purpose | Format | Safe to edit? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `~/termocode-settings.json` | Default target of Preferences: Export Settings…. | Settings bundle: `{"termocode_settings": 1, "files": {...}}`. State files and secrets are left out. | Yes, but re-export is easier. |
| `~/.local/share/fonts/JetBrainsMonoNF/` | Nerd Font installed by `termocode setup` (Linux). | Font files. | Safe to delete. |
| `~/.cache/termocode/mcp/<name>.tools.json` | Tool list of each MCP server, so a chat turn does not start the server just to list its tools. `$XDG_CACHE_HOME` moves it. | JSON, written by termocode; keyed by a hash of the server's mcp.json entry. | Safe to delete. |

**Preferences: Export Settings…** writes all config-folder JSON files into one bundle, except state files (`session.json`, `recents.json`, `workspaces.json`, `palette_recents.json`) and anything that looks like a secret.
